result.title: Operation-aware Multimodal Clinical Decision Support System for ICU Discharge Risk Assessment
result.summary: Unplanned 30-day intensive care unit (ICU) readmission is a critical benchmark for evaluating healthcare quality. Most predictive models assume readmission risk depends solely on a patient's individual pathophysiological state, ignoring hospital operational context and resource capacity. In practice, discharge decisions are dynamic trade-offs between patient stability and bed turnover pressures. To address this gap, we develop an Operation-aware Multimodal Clinical Decision Support System (CDSS) for ICU discharge risk assessment. The system combines multi-agent collaborative extraction with self-evolving retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to eliminate template noise from progress notes, while constructing departmental workload indicators alongside admission flow features, continuous vital signs, and sparse medical codes (ICD/DRG). Addressing severe class imbalance (about 10.5% readmissions) and alarm fatigue, we implement data normalization, class reweighting, and decision-threshold calibration. In 20 independent runs across 20,000 ICU stays from MIMIC-III, empirical findings demonstrate that: vital signs alone have limited predictive capacity under real-world class imbalance (PR-AUC of 0.1387 +/- 0.0086); directly concatenating raw text embeddings degrades decision tree performance (XGBoost and LightGBM PR-AUC drop to 0.3893 and 0.4030); whereas an end-to-end multimodal fine-tuning architecture (Transformer E2E FineTune) utilizing layer-wise parameter freezing and differential learning rates reverses text negative transfer, achieving the highest AUROC of 0.8288 +/- 0.0110, PR-AUC of 0.4373 +/- 0.0310, and F1-Score of 0.4757 +/- 0.0196. Operational indicators supply independent risk signals, laying an engineering foundation for high-utility clinical decision support tools.

AI.brief_summary: 研究 ICU 出院后 30 天非计划再入院的风险预测，构建融合生命体征、ICD/DRG 编码、科室负荷指标与病程记录文本的多模态临床决策支持系统，并用多智能体抽取加自演化 RAG 降噪、类别重加权与阈值校准应对类别不平衡。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“多模态”仅指表格化临床特征与文本的融合，不涉及视觉细节、实体关系或几何信息，也未研究 latent 推理状态的生成、使用或证据筛选，而是常规风险评分预测任务，与 LVR 主线缺少可核查的借鉴线索，故排除。
